title: POST /api/integrations/sela/threads/{id}/messages request
description: sela appends a message to an existing thread and may set the next awaiting value.

awaiting.description: Defaults to human: sela normally posts and then waits for the human. Using sela makes the thread immediately available again to the inbox runner.

seen_revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency token. When present and not equal to the current revision the write is rejected with 409.
